title: 微生物组干预策略的临床转化现状
purpose: 使读者清晰掌握当前微生物组干预策略（FMT、LBP、益生菌、饮食/代谢物）在实体瘤 ICI 治疗中的临床证据等级、核心试验设计特征、关键安全性发现及方法学局限；理解为何现有阳性信号尚未转化为指南推荐；明确缺乏 Phase III RCT 确证的关键缺口及未来标准化研究的设计方向。
scope: 肠道微生物组干预在实体瘤免疫检查点抑制剂（ICI）治疗中的临床转化仍处于早期探索阶段。尽管粪菌移植（FMT）、活体生物药（LBP）、益生菌及饮食/代谢物干预在多项 Phase I/II 试验中展现出恢复或增强抗肿瘤免疫的潜力，但现有证据高度依赖单臂设计、小样本队列及异质性极高的供体/菌株配方。截至 2026 年中，尚无已完成的 Phase III 随机对照试验确证其疗效；安全性信号（如双免背景下的严重 irAEs）与定植效率瓶颈进一步凸显了从观察性关联向因果性临床获益转化的鸿沟。本综述的核心论点是：微生物组干预具有明确的生物学合理性与早期临床信号，但其作为标准辅助疗法的地位需等待大规模、标准化、多中心 III 期 RCT 的确证，当前应严格区分概念验证信号与确证性疗效，并将资源优先投向供体筛选算法、菌株功能验证及代谢物定量标准化。
thesis: 肠道微生物组干预在实体瘤免疫检查点抑制剂（ICI）治疗中的临床转化仍处于早期探索阶段。尽管粪菌移植（FMT）、活体生物药（LBP）、益生菌及饮食/代谢物干预在多项 Phase I/II 试验中展现出恢复或增强抗肿瘤免疫的潜力，但现有证据高度依赖单臂设计、小样本队列及异质性极高的供体/菌株配方。截至 2026 年中，尚无已完成的 Phase III 随机对照试验确证其疗效；安全性信号（如双免背景下的严重 irAEs）与定植效率瓶颈进一步凸显了从观察性关联向因果性临床获益转化的鸿沟。本综述的核心论点是：微生物组干预具有明确的生物学合理性与早期临床信号，但其作为标准辅助疗法的地位需等待大规模、标准化、多中心 III 期 RCT 的确证，当前应严格区分概念验证信号与确证性疗效，并将资源优先投向供体筛选算法、菌株功能验证及代谢物定量标准化。
reader_objective: 使读者清晰掌握当前微生物组干预策略（FMT、LBP、益生菌、饮食/代谢物）在实体瘤 ICI 治疗中的临床证据等级、核心试验设计特征、关键安全性发现及方法学局限；理解为何现有阳性信号尚未转化为指南推荐；明确缺乏 Phase III RCT 确证的关键缺口及未来标准化研究的设计方向。
research_question: How does the gut microbiome modulate the efficacy of immune checkpoint inhibitors in solid tumours, and what mechanisms mediate that effect?
review_argument: 本综述涵盖实体瘤（黑色素瘤、非小细胞肺癌、肾细胞癌、结直肠癌等）患者接受免疫检查点抑制剂（PD-1/PD-L1、CTLA-4 抑制剂）治疗的情境。重点分析肠道微生物组组成（分类学）、功能（代谢通路）及特定代谢产物（短链脂肪酸、肌苷、胆汁酸）与 ICI 疗效（ORR、PFS、OS）的关联。纳入临床观察性研究、干预性试验（FMT、益生菌、饮食）及机制研究（动物模型、体外实验）。基于实际材料，本综述明确当前干预性证据主要来自 I/II 期试验（如 FMT-LUMINate、TACITO、MITRIC），尚无已完成的大规模 III 期 RCT 确证疗效。代谢物定量数据部分可得（CheckMate 025 队列肌苷分层数据），但缺乏人体肿瘤微环境绝对浓度标准化测量。排除血液系统恶性肿瘤、非 ICI 免疫疗法及纯方法学论文。

other_chapters.title: 肠道微生物组与 ICI 疗效的临床关联证据
other_chapters.purpose: 读者应能准确区分不同实体瘤中微生物特征与ICI疗效的观察性关联强度，理解抗生素暴露的时间窗口依赖性及其对预后的量化损害，并能客观评估早期FMT/益生菌干预信号的证据等级与局限，为后续机制探讨与转化规划奠定事实基础。

other_chapters.title: 微生物调节免疫治疗的分子与细胞机制
other_chapters.purpose: 使读者掌握微生物组调节ICI疗效的三大机制路径及其分子靶点，清晰区分临床前因果验证与人类观察性证据的边界，理解UBA6作为肌苷作用替代标志物的代理性质，并明确当前绝对浓度测量缺口对转化医学的限制，从而建立从基础机制到临床转化的审慎评估框架。

other_chapters.title: 影响微生物组效应的情境因素
other_chapters.purpose: 掌握治疗方案、合并用药、宿主特征及肿瘤生物学如何作为关键调节变量修饰“肠道微生物组-免疫”互作；理解为何不同队列中微生物标志物与ICI疗效的关联存在显著差异；明确当前证据的适用边界、方法学局限及未来标准化需求。

other_chapters.title: 方法学挑战与未来研究方向
other_chapters.purpose: 为肿瘤科医师与转化医学研究者提供当前证据边界的批判性评估框架，使其能够区分稳健的观察性信号与过早的临床宣称，理解为何 III 期确证试验尚未完成，掌握代谢物定量与队列设计的方法学标准，并据此规划或解读未来的微生物组-ICI 临床研究。

units.title: unit 1
units.substantive_point: FMT 在 ICI 耐药或初治人群中的概念验证信号与临床结局异质性
units.ordered_development: 按试验设计类型（单臂概念验证 vs. 随机对照）与肿瘤背景（黑色素瘤 vs. NSCLC/RCC/CRC）组织证据，对比不同给药途径（口服胶囊 vs. 结肠镜）与供体来源（健康人 vs. ICI 响应者）对客观缓解率（ORR）、无进展生存期（PFS）及免疫相关不良事件（irAEs）的影响，揭示疗效信号与毒性风险的并存现象。

paragraph_briefs.point: 确立 FMT 联合 ICI 的概念验证基础与早期阳性信号
paragraph_briefs.development: 对比 MIMic（P0577）与 FMT-LUMINate（P0583）的单臂设计结果，展示健康供体 FMT 在黑色素瘤和 NSCLC 初治人群中实现的高 ORR（65%-80%），并指出这些研究为后续随机试验提供了效应量估算依据。

paragraph_briefs.point: 揭示 FMT 疗效的肿瘤类型特异性与随机对照试验的复杂结果
paragraph_briefs.development: 对比 TACITO（P0602）在 mRCC 中的 Phase 2a RCT 结果（中位 PFS 24.0 vs 9.0 个月，HR=0.50，但主要终点 12 个月 PFS 率未达显著 p=0.053）与 MITRIC（P0578/P0590）在广泛耐药篮子试验中的阴性结果（ORR 0%），论证 FMT 并非普适性挽救疗法，其获益高度依赖基线免疫状态、疾病进展速度及供体匹配度。

paragraph_briefs.point: 阐明给药途径与供体来源对定植动力学及临床结局的修饰作用
paragraph_briefs.development: 比较 FMT-LUMINate（P0583）的口服胶囊递送与 TACITO（P0602）的结肠镜+胶囊组合在菌群定植（DoSER）与α/β多样性变化上的差异；分析 MITRIC（P0578）中供体粪便仅实现短暂定植且未能重塑外周髓系/淋巴细胞景观的现象，提示单次或有限次给药可能不足以克服深度失调。

case_uses.text: 提供FMT联合ICI的汇总疗效数据（ORR 43%）及亚组分析，用于论证不同供体来源与给药途径对临床结局的趋势性影响，并量化安全性边界。
补充消化道肿瘤中抗生素预处理FMT（A-FMT）的早期可行性与微生物组趋同证据，作为对比健康供体FMT在特定解剖部位定植策略的对照案例。
提供FMT联合抗PD-1在难治性黑色素瘤患者中的I期临床试验数据，展示肿瘤放射学反应与CD8+ T细胞浸润增加的直接关联，用于论证FMT作为克服ICI原发性耐药的临床可行性及免疫重塑表型。
基于418名NSCLC患者基线宏基因组数据构建机器学习预测模型，模拟健康供体FMT与治疗性菌群组合的定植依赖性响应提升，用于补充计算生物学视角下FMT疗效预测与精准供体匹配的方法学对照。

units.evidence_conditions: 所有 FMT 数据均来源于 Phase I/II 单臂或小样本 RCT，存在选择偏倚与历史对照混杂。黑色素瘤队列中观察到较高的 3 级以上 irAEs（65%），提示双免背景下 FMT 可能放大免疫激活风险。供体均为单一或少量个体，外推至混合供体或健康人群需谨慎。
units.transition: 鉴于 FMT 操作侵入性强、供体异质性高且监管复杂，领域正转向定义明确的活体生物药（LBP）与益生菌制剂，以期实现可规模化生产的标准化干预。

units.title: unit 2
units.substantive_point: 活体生物药（LBP）与益生菌的菌株特异性、制造挑战及早期临床信号
units.ordered_development: 按产品复杂度（单菌株 LBP vs. 共培养生态系统疗法 vs. 商业益生菌）分类，评估其在 ICI 背景下的安全性、微生物组重塑能力及初步疗效信号，重点剖析 CBM588、MRx0518、MET4/MaaT034 及 SER-401 等候选产品的开发路径与失败教训。

paragraph_briefs.point: 单菌株与定义菌群 LBP 的临床前机制与早期人体安全性
paragraph_briefs.development: 阐述 MRx0518（P0125/P0230）在 ICI 耐药实体瘤中的 Part A 安全性通过情况及其基于 TLR5/NF-κB 通路的免疫调节假说；对比 MET4（P0552/P0242）与 MaaT034（P0473/P0522）共培养产品在无菌鼠模型中成功定植、产生 SCFA/吲哚/次级胆汁酸并改善肠道生理的体外/体内证据，强调其作为“后生元”替代方案的潜力。

paragraph_briefs.point: CBM588 在 RCC 中的阳性信号与商业化益生菌的负面警示
paragraph_briefs.development: 引用 P0006/P0143/P0090 中 CBM588 联合 nivo/ipi 或 cabo/nivo 在 mRCC 中显著提升 ORR（58%-74%）与延长 PFS 的数据，同时对比 P0357/P0454/P0572 指出的非靶向商业益生菌补充剂可能与较低 ICI 响应率及较差 PFS 相关，论证菌株特异性与生态位竞争的重要性。

paragraph_briefs.point: SER-401 试验失败的方法学教训与制造/监管障碍
paragraph_briefs.development: 分析 P0150/P0473 中 SER-401 因万古霉素预处理导致目标厚壁菌门孢子定植失败、引发系统性炎症且疗效不优于安慰剂的案例，指出抗生素预处理策略的双刃剑效应；结合 P0150/P0473 讨论 LBP 在 GMP 生产、冻干复苏、胃酸耐受及 FDA/EMA 监管框架下面临的工程化瓶颈。

case_uses.text: 提供MB097九菌株联合制剂的临床前机制与MELODY-1试验背景，用于说明从相关性发现到标准化定义菌群（LBP）转化的具体路径及当前局限。
展示MET4联合体诱导宿主特异性IgG及外周免疫亚群重塑的早期人体数据，用于补充活体生物药除局部代谢物外的体液免疫调节维度及个体反应异质性。

units.evidence_conditions: LBP 数据主要来自 Phase I/II 或会议摘要，缺乏长期随访。CBM588 的阳性结果来自单中心小样本 RCT，可能存在中心偏倚。商业益生菌的负面关联多为回顾性观察，混杂因素（如患者基线菌群、合并用药）未完全控制。GMP 标准与冷链物流限制全球可及性。
units.transition: 除直接补充活菌外，通过饮食调整或外源性代谢物补充来间接重塑微生物组功能，提供了一种非侵入性且易于标准化的替代路径，但其临床转化同样面临剂量优化与个体响应差异的挑战。

units.title: unit 3
units.substantive_point: 饮食干预与代谢物补充的非药物调节潜力及临床可行性
units.ordered_development: 聚焦 DIET 试验（P0593/P0629/P0598）等高纤维饮食干预、黑树莓花蜜（BRB）及生酮饮食（MSKD）的随机对照设计，评估其对临床终点（EFS/ORR）、外周免疫表型及微生物组/代谢物谱的调控作用，并与直接代谢物补充策略进行对比。

paragraph_briefs.point: DIET 试验中高纤维饮食对临床终点与外周免疫的重塑
paragraph_briefs.development: 详述 DIET 试验（P0593/P0629）的完全受控喂食设计（50g/d vs 20g/d），报告联合新辅助/不可切除队列中 EFS 显著改善（p=0.03）及 IRAEs 发生率降低的趋势；结合 P0598 的 CyTOF/NanoString 数据，说明高纤维组循环单核细胞/DC 减少而效应记忆 T 细胞增加，并通过人源小鼠 FMT 验证了菌群介导的 ICI 反应增强。

paragraph_briefs.point: 植物多酚与生酮饮食对特定代谢通路及菌群网络的影响
paragraph_briefs.development: 对比 BRB 干预（P0497/P0500）中 Lachnospiraceae 富集及小鼠模型中肿瘤体积缩小的发现，与 MSKD（P0653）中 Akkermansia、Roseburia hominis 及磷脂酸代谢通路上调的宏基因组结果；指出饮食干预虽能稳定改变菌群结构，但 DIET 试验的微生物组中介分析数据仍在进行中，尚未完成统计学中介验证。

paragraph_briefs.point: 外源性代谢物补充的药代动力学挑战与靶向递送前景
paragraph_briefs.development: 讨论肌苷、SCFAs 及次级胆汁酸作为直接干预物的潜力，引用 P0649 中肌苷通过 A2AR-cAMP-CREB 通路促进 Th1 分化的机制，以及 P0609/P0638 中建立的 LC-MS/GC-MS 绝对定量方法学；指出当前缺乏肿瘤微环境（TME）或血清中代谢物浓度的标准化参考范围，限制了剂量-效应关系的精确建立。

case_uses.text: 提供限时进食（TRE）通过重塑色氨酸代谢物改善肾癌ICI响应的因果链条，作为非药物饮食干预克服原发耐药的实证案例及代谢重编程机制例证。
展示天然多酚castalagin特异性结合Ruminococcus并逆转抗PD-1耐药的小鼠模型证据，用于阐释植物源性益生元通过靶向特定菌属改变胆汁酸代谢的机制。

units.evidence_conditions: DIET 试验为 Phase II 随机对照，但主要终点为微生物组结构，临床终点为探索性；样本量（N=45）限制亚组分析。BRB 与 MSKD 数据多来自早期试验或动物模型外推。代谢物定量方法仅在血清/尿液验证，TME 原位浓度测量仍属空白。依从性（>80%）与长期饮食维持是实际推广障碍。
units.transition: 综合上述三类干预策略，当前证据呈现出明显的“信号强烈但确证不足”特征。安全性管理、供体/菌株匹配及方法学标准化构成跨越早期试验至常规护理的主要屏障。

units.title: unit 4
units.substantive_point: 安全性边界、实施挑战与 III 期确证需求的综合评估
units.ordered_development: 系统梳理 FMT 与 LBP 相关的 irAEs 风险谱（特别是心肌炎与结肠炎）、供体筛查算法的缺失、给药途径的依从性差异，并结合 P0600/P0601/P0608 确认的 Phase III 证据缺口，提出未来临床试验设计的优先级与标准化路线图。

paragraph_briefs.point: 微生物组干预的毒性谱系与免疫激活的双刃剑效应
paragraph_briefs.development: 对比 FMT-LUMINate（P0583）中 Prevotella copri 供体与双免背景叠加导致的早期严重 irAEs（包括 2 例心肌炎）与 TACITO（P0602）中良好的耐受性记录；引用 P0357/P0454 关于益生菌可能诱发机会性感染或加重炎症的警告，论证微生物组重塑必然伴随免疫稳态的剧烈波动，需建立前瞻性毒性监测协议。

paragraph_briefs.point: 供体筛选、定植效率与给药途径的实施瓶颈
paragraph_briefs.development: 分析 MITRIC（P0578）中供体-受体匹配失败与短暂定植的教训，对比 FMT-LUMINate（P0583）口服胶囊的便捷性与结肠镜的彻底性；结合 P0150/P0473 中 SER-401 的失败，强调“清除-填充”策略需避免广谱抗生素的脱靶毒性，并呼吁开发基于宏基因组功能的供体智能匹配算法。

paragraph_briefs.point: III 期 RCT 确证缺口与未来标准化研究范式
paragraph_briefs.development: 基于 P0600/P0601/P0608 的系统评价结论，明确声明截至 2026 年中尚无已完成的大规模 Phase III RCT 证实任何微生物组干预在 ICI 中的生存获益；指出 CanBiome2（NCT06623461）等正在进行的多中心试验将提供关键验证；呼吁统一采样保存（如 DESS）、鸟枪法宏基因组测序、代谢物绝对定量（μM/ng/mL）及盲态独立中心审查（BICR）的标准操作流程。

case_uses.text: 提供结肠炎型irAEs患者粪便特征及小鼠FMT致致死性结肠炎的因果验证，用于界定微生物组干预的安全毒性谱系及产丁酸菌缺失的潜在病理关联。

units.transition: 本章证据表明，微生物组干预已从理论假设步入早期临床验证阶段，但距离成为实体瘤 ICI 治疗的常规组成部分仍有实质性距离。下一章将深入探讨支撑这些临床发现的底层方法学挑战、多组学整合瓶颈及人工智能驱动的精准分层路径。

chapter_tool_materials.question: 是否存在已完成的、大规模随机对照 III 期试验证实微生物组干预在 ICI 治疗患者中的疗效？
chapter_tool_materials.usable_content: 本研究（MITRIC 试验，NCT05286294）是一项单臂、IIa 期篮子试验，纳入 12 名对免疫检查点抑制剂（ICI）耐药的晚期癌症患者（主要为黑色素瘤，另有头颈鳞癌、肾细胞癌、胰腺癌各 1 例）。研究评估了来自 ICI 长期响应者的粪便微生物移植（FMT）联合 ICI 治疗的安全性和有效性。主要结果显示客观缓解率（ORR）为 0%（0/12），中位无进展生存期（PFS）为 1.5 个月，中位总生存期（OS）为 10.1 个月。仅 1 例黑色素瘤患者达到方案定义的临床获益（稳定疾病>6 个月）。安全性方面，FMT 耐受性良好，50% 患者发生免疫相关不良事件（irAEs），多为 1-2 级。研究还通过质谱流式细胞术分析了外周血免疫细胞，发现基线高分化 T 细胞特征与较好预后相关，而髓系优势环境与不良预后相关，且 FMT 未显著改变外周血免疫景观。 This study reports results from a Phase II trial (FMT-LUMINate, NCT04951583) involving 20 previously untreated patients with advanced melanoma receiving fecal microbiota transplantation (FMT) combined with dual immune checkpoint inhibitors (ipilimumab and nivolumab). The design was single-arm with safety as the primary endpoint. The authors observed an objective response rate (ORR) of 70% (2 complete responses, 12 partial responses), but also noted high rates of immune-related adverse events (65% grade >3, including 20% diarrhea/colitis and 2 cases of myocarditis). The conclusion states that these results support the study of FMT and immunotherapy in the randomized setting, indicating that definitive randomized evidence is not yet established by this work.
limits: 需要检索是否有已完成的、针对微生物组干预（如 FMT 或特定菌群制剂）联合免疫检查点抑制剂的大型 III 期随机对照试验及其主要结局数据。

chapter_tool_materials.usable_content: This study is a narrative review of 95 clinical studies (2015–2025) evaluating the gut microbiome in cancer immunotherapy. The authors report that current evidence primarily consists of observational cohorts and early-phase interventional studies (e.g., Phase I/II trials of fecal microbiota transplantation in melanoma achieving 20–40% objective response rates). The GRADE assessment explicitly states that high-certainty evidence was not reached in any domain due to methodological heterogeneity, open-label designs, and reliance on observational cohorts. The authors emphasize the need for large-scale, multi-center randomized controlled trials to validate the microbiome's role but do not list specific ongoing key Phase 3 trials (such as CanBiome2) or provide estimated completion times. 该研究通过检索 Trialtrove 数据库（截至 2025 年 6 月 30 日），分析了 29 项评估微生物组调节剂（MMs）治疗结直肠癌（CRC）的临床试验。结果显示，试验管线主要由早期阶段主导：II 期试验 9 项，I 期 7 项，I/II 期 7 项，未列出已完成的 III 期试验。文中具体引用了 RENMIN-215 试验（II 期）的数据，显示 FMT 联合免疫治疗在难治性 MSS mCRC 患者中取得 ORR 20%、mPFS 9.6 个月的结果。作者明确指出“虽然 MMs 在 CRC 中的临床管线仍 predominantly early-phase（主要为早期阶段）”，这直接回应了关于是否存在已完成 III 期试验的疑问（即目前尚无）。 This study conducted a proof-of-principle randomized trial (NCT04645680) with 45 melanoma patients receiving immune checkpoint blockade, comparing a high-fiber diet intervention (50g/d) against a control diet (20g/d). The authors reported exploratory clinical outcomes including event-free survival (EFS), objective response rate (ORR), and immune-related adverse events (IRAEs). Results indicated a significant EFS benefit in the combined neoadjuvant/unresectable cohort (p=0.03) and a trend in ORR (p=0.06), with lower IRAE rates in the intervention arm. The authors explicitly concluded that these findings warrant further study in Phase III trials powered for disease outcomes. 本研究（CONTACT-03）是一项已完成的 III 期随机对照试验，评估了在既往免疫检查点抑制剂（ICI）治疗进展后的转移性肾细胞癌患者中，在酪氨酸激酶抑制剂（cabozantinib）基础上加用抗 PD-L1 药物（atezolizumab） versus 单药治疗的疗效。研究结果显示，联合组并未改善无进展生存期（PFS）或总生存期（OS），且毒性增加。虽然该研究未涉及微生物组干预，但其作为 ICI 再挑战策略失败的阴性证据，支持了综述中关于‘现有临床策略在 ICI 耐药人群中效果有限’的背景论述，从而间接突显了探索非传统机制（如微生物组干预）的必要性。 This study analyzed access to immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) in patients randomized to the control arm across 8 international phase 3 trials for renal cell carcinoma (RCC) and urothelial carcinoma (UC). It found that approximately 57% of control arm patients in RCC trials and 59% in UC trials received subsequent therapy, with 67% and 75% of those subsequent therapies being ICIs, respectively. The authors noted significant variability between trials, with some showing low access rates (e.g., 40.5% in CheckMate 9ER, 33.5% in KEYNOTE-564). The supplied text explicitly addresses the status of Phase III trials in the section 'Large-scale clinical evidence, meta-analytic synthesis, and long-term safety follow-up.' It states: 'as of late 2025, no completed Phase III randomized trials have yet confirmed a reproducible survival benefit of microbiome-based interventions in oncology.' The authors note that current evidence relies on Phase I/II trials (e.g., FMT studies NCT03353402, NCT03341143) and meta-analyses. The text lists several ongoing early-phase trials for engineered microbes (e.g., SYNB1891, MRx0518, SER-401) but does not provide completion dates or specific details for a Phase III trial named 'CanBiome2'. It does, however, mention a dietary intervention trial (NCT04645680) and a multi-strain probiotic trial (NCT03829111) as ongoing or emerging, without specifying them as Phase III. This study surveyed 29 clinical trials of microbiome modulators in colorectal cancer (CRC) as of June 30, 2025, finding that the pipeline is predominantly early-phase (Phase I, I/II, and II), with no mention of completed Phase 3 randomized controlled trials (RCTs) publishing primary endpoints like overall survival (OS) or progression-free survival (PFS). It reports efficacy data from Phase II trials (e.g., RENMIN-215 trial showing 20% ORR and 9.6 months mPFS with FMT plus ICIs in MSS CRC) and meta-analyses of early-phase trials, explicitly stating that 'the clinical pipeline for MMs in CRC remains predominantly early-phase'. This confirms the absence of completed large-scale Phase 3 evidence in the surveyed literature. This study describes an investigator-initiated, randomized, phase II trial (NCT06030037) evaluating P+L versus P+L plus responder-derived fecal microbiota transplantation (R-FMT) in PD-1 resistant/refractory melanoma. The text specifies the intervention protocol: R-FMT is derived from donors with durable response (mPFS ≥24 months) following prior PD-1 ICI, screened for infectious agents, and administered via endoscopy on D1 and D42 followed by oral capsules. The primary endpoint is objective response rate (ORR) by Blinded Independent Central Review, with secondary endpoints including progression-free survival (PFS) and overall survival (OS). Translational endpoints include immune activation, metagenomic engraftment, and transcriptomic analyses. Enrollment has commenced, but no efficacy results are reported. This study is a narrative review of 95 clinical studies (2015–2025) evaluating the gut microbiome in cancer immunotherapy. The authors report that current evidence primarily consists of observational cohorts and early-phase interventional studies (e.g., Phase I/II trials of fecal microbiota transplantation in melanoma achieving 20–40% objective response rates). The GRADE assessment explicitly states that high-certainty evidence was not reached in any domain due to methodological heterogeneity, open-label designs, and reliance on observational cohorts. The authors emphasize the need for large-scale, multi-center randomized controlled trials to validate the microbiome's role but do not list specific ongoing key Phase 3 trials (such as CanBiome2) or provide estimated completion times. 该研究通过检索 Trialtrove 数据库（截至 2025 年 6 月 30 日），分析了 29 项评估微生物组调节剂（MMs）治疗结直肠癌（CRC）的临床试验。结果显示，试验管线主要由早期阶段主导：II 期试验 9 项，I 期 7 项，I/II 期 7 项，未列出已完成的 III 期试验。文中具体引用了 RENMIN-215 试验（II 期）的数据，显示 FMT 联合免疫治疗在难治性 MSS mCRC 患者中取得 ORR 20%、mPFS 9.6 个月的结果。作者明确指出“虽然 MMs 在 CRC 中的临床管线仍 predominantly early-phase（主要为早期阶段）”，这直接回应了关于是否存在已完成 III 期试验的疑问（即目前尚无）。

chapter_tool_materials.question: 人体肿瘤微环境或血清中关键代谢物（肌苷、短链脂肪酸）的绝对生理浓度标准化测量方法是否已建立？
chapter_tool_materials.usable_content: This study developed and validated an LC-MS/MS method for quantifying adenosine, guanosine, and inosine nucleotides (mono- and triphosphate forms) in human peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs), red blood cells (RBCs), and dried blood spots (DBS). The authors reported absolute quantification ranges (e.g., inosine triphosphate 0.25–50 pmol/sample) with interassay precision ≤15% and accuracy within −11.5% to 14.7%. Key findings include significantly higher nucleotide concentrations in PBMCs compared to RBCs (5.6-fold for ITP) and instability of triphosphates in DBS samples (26% lower TP levels due to hydrolysis). The method requires solid-phase extraction and dephosphorylation steps to measure molar equivalent nucleosides, with strict controls for environmental contamination affecting low-abundance analytes like ITP. This study investigated the mechanism by which gut microbiota enhance immune checkpoint blockade (ICB) therapy in colorectal cancer using mouse models. The authors identified inosine as a critical bacterial metabolite that promotes Th1 cell differentiation via the A2A receptor. They quantified absolute inosine concentrations in mouse serum and intestinal contents using untargeted metabolomics and fragmentation analysis (e.g., serum inosine in B.p. monocolonized mice was 26.16 ± 3.32µM; duodenal content was 66.13 ±14.23 µM). This material helps the gap by confirming that inosine is a quantifiable metabolite of interest and providing example concentration ranges in a biological system, demonstrating the feasibility of measuring absolute levels (µM) in serum and tissue contexts. This study describes a validated high-throughput LC-MS/MS method for absolute quantification of thyroid hormones and metabolites in human serum, employing dansyl chloride derivatization to enhance sensitivity. The authors report detailed validation parameters including recovery (73–115%), precision (CVs 1.2–16.4%), and method limits of quantification (MQL) in pg/mL or ng/mL, adhering to European Analytical Guidelines (2002/657/EC). This provides a concrete methodological template for what a standardized absolute concentration measurement workflow looks like in serum, including sample preparation (protein precipitation, SPE, ultrafiltration), derivatization optimization, and matrix effect evaluation. This study describes a validated gas chromatography-mass spectrometry (GC-MS) protocol for the absolute quantification of 14 short-chain fatty acids (SCFAs) in human serum and fecal samples. The authors detail an alkaline extraction method (pH > 7) followed by derivatization with MTBSTFA, which allows for direct injection and sensitive detection. The protocol includes the use of chemical standards to construct calibration curves for calculating absolute concentrations (e.g., μM), and provides specific retention times and quantification masses for compounds including acetic, propionic, and butyric acid. The text references normal concentration ranges for SCFAs in human blood (e.g., acetic acid 26.8 to 64.2 μM) based on metabolomics databases. 该研究详细描述了一种用于血清和尿液中 10 种短链脂肪酸（SCFAs）及相关代谢物绝对定量的 GC-MS 检测方法，包括内标使用（甲基硬脂酸）、样品前处理（酸化、衍生化）、仪器参数及方法验证指标（线性、精密度、准确度、回收率）。研究明确指出采样时间标准化对 SCFA 浓度测量的重要性，因为昼夜波动的影响大于饮食干预的影响。这为血清中 SCFA 绝对浓度（μmol/L）的测量提供了具体的方法学参考和标准化采样时间的依据。 This study developed and validated an LC-MS/MS method for quantifying adenosine, guanosine, and inosine nucleotides (mono- and triphosphate forms) in human peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs), red blood cells (RBCs), and dried blood spots (DBS). chapter_tool_materials.still_missing: The specific success criteria for standardized measurement in human tumor microenvironment or serum remain unaddressed, as this study focused on blood cell lysates. There is no evidence of a consensus guideline or widely adopted standard for serum/tumor metabolite quantification in this text. Additionally, short-chain fatty acids (SCFAs) are not covered, only purine nucleotides. The study represents a single-laboratory validation rather than a field-wide consensus.

chapter_tool_materials.question: Does the DIET trial (NCT04645680) or other human dietary intervention trials report specific gut microbiome compositional or functional changes that statistically mediate the observed clinical efficacy improvements in ICI-treated patients?
chapter_tool_materials.usable_content: This study reports specific gut microbiome compositional and functional changes associated with a medically supervised ketogenic diet (MSKD) intervention in humans. Taxonomical findings include significant enrichment of Akkermansia muciniphila (p=0.017931), Intestinimonas butyriciproducens (p=3.09E-05), Streptococcus thermophilus (p=1.15E-05), Roseburia hominis (p=3.94E-05), and Lacticaseibacillus rhamnosus (p=7.28E-19) in the MSKD group compared to standard diet. Functional profiling identified increased phosphatidate metabolism (PWY-7039) and allantoin degradation (PWY-5705), with reduced L-ascorbate biosynthesis (PWY-6415). The authors note that Akkermansia muciniphila is linked to improved response to immune checkpoint inhibitors in existing literature. The study demonstrates that dietary intervention can produce sustained microbiome changes during cancer therapy, with MSKD patients showing better overall treatment responses and distinct microbiome profiles throughout therapy. This study explicitly states in the Discussion section that 'Subsequent mediation analysis on gut microbiome was not able to be performed' due to limitations including small sample size for dietary data (N=34). It reports observational associations between baseline dietary patterns (specifically high fat and dairy intake) and gut microbiome composition (e.g., Firmicutes unclassified, Ruminococcaceae, Intestinimonas, Enterobacteriaceae) with ICI clinical outcomes (PFS, HPD status) in NSCLC patients. The authors note that while dietary patterns were associated with HPD, the sample size prevented statistical significance for diet-outcome links and precluded mediation modeling. This study reports secondary objectives from the DIET trial (NCT04645680), a randomized controlled feeding study in melanoma patients receiving immune checkpoint blockade (ICB). The authors found that a high fiber diet reduced unconjugated secondary bile acids and secondary-to-primary bile acid ratios in serum compared to control. The authors attribute these metabolic changes to reduced gut microbiota-mediated biotransformation of primary bile acids (cholic acid, chenodeoxycholic acid) into secondary bile acids (deoxycholic acid, lithocholic acid, ursodeoxycholic acid). In mouse avatar models using fecal microbiota transplant from trial participants, recipients of post-high fiber diet microbiota showed improved ICB response and decreased secondary-to-primary bile acid ratios. The authors conclude that dietary fiber modulates microbiome-mediated secondary bile acid synthesis linked to ICB response. This study reports secondary objectives of the DIET trial (NCT04645680), a phase II randomized double-blinded dietary intervention in melanoma patients receiving immune checkpoint blockade (ICB). Patients were randomized (2:1) to a high fiber diet (30-50 g/d) or healthy control diet (20 g/d). The authors measured peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMC) using NanoString gene expression and CyTOF mass cytometry. Findings included decreased abundance scores of circulating macrophages, neutrophils, classical monocytes, and dendritic cells, alongside higher T cell activation gene signatures in the high fiber arm versus control within week 5-8. Human-to-mouse fecal microbiota transplant (FMT) studies using patient stool collected pre or post intervention revealed improved ICB response in mice receiving post-high fiber diet stool, suggesting microbiome-dependent benefits. This study is a protocol publication for the DIET trial (NCT04645680), a randomized, double-blind, controlled feeding study comparing a high-fiber dietary intervention (50 g/day) to a control diet (20 g/day) in melanoma patients receiving immune checkpoint blockade. The authors explicitly state in the Data Availability section that 'No datasets were generated or analysed during the current study,' which serves as an explicit statement that microbiome mediation data is currently pending/unavailable in this report (addressing success criterion 3). The text details the planned methodology to address the gap, including whole-genome shotgun sequencing of stool samples, metabolomic profiling (SCFAs, bile acids), and planned statistical analyses to explore associations between microbiome profiles and clinical outcomes (ORR, PFS). The planned analysis involves longitudinal microbiome profiling (WGS sequencing) and statistical comparisons (linear mixed effects models, correlations) to explore associations between microbiome profiles and immunity/outcomes. Crucially, the Data Availability section states 'No datasets were generated or analysed during the current study,' indicating that results regarding microbiome mediation are not contained in this document. This study investigated a 6-week whole-food-based high-fiber dietary intervention in 10 melanoma survivors, utilizing whole genome sequencing and microbial association network analysis (NetCoMi). It reported specific microbiome compositional changes, including increased community connectivity and increased centrality of known fiber-responsive and Short Chain Fatty Acid (SCFA)-producing taxa. The authors identified Ruminococcus bromii and Dorea longicatena as potential keystone species consistently showing increased centrality and associations with fiber-responsive taxa across different association statistics. These findings provide specific candidate taxa and functional groups (SCFA producers) that could be relevant for mediation analyses in ICI-treated populations. This study reports an observational cohort analysis (n=128 for survival analysis, n=438 for profiling) in melanoma patients receiving immune checkpoint blockade (ICB). The authors found that higher dietary fiber intake was associated with significantly improved progression-free survival (PFS), while the use of over-the-counter probiotic supplements was associated with impaired response. The study included fecal microbiota profiling and parallel preclinical mouse models. In mice, low-fiber diet or probiotic use led to impaired anti-PD-1 treatment response and a lower frequency of interferon-γ–positive cytotoxic T cells in the tumor microenvironment. The authors state that gut bacteria modulate ICB response but the mechanisms underlying microbiota effects are presently unclear.
